Pillow 12.3.0 ImageFont.load_default(size=32) uses a limited-character version of Aileron Regular. Designer: Sora Sagano (佐賀野 宇宙). The author's https://dotcolon.net/fonts/aileron page declares https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ as its license (retrieved 2026-10-04 UTC; page JSON-LD license field). No font file is copied by this plugin; Pillow embeds the subset. A local copy of the CC0 legalcode is retained here.
